title: lyrics.json — timed lyrics with confidence and honesty flags
description: Produced either by aligning a supplied lyrics file to the audio (mode 'aligned') or by transcribing the isolated vocal stem with Whisper (mode 'transcribed'). Uncertainty is explicit: per-word confidence, per-line flags, untranscribed_regions listing sung passages the system could not read, and (aligned mode) unmatched_words listing words Whisper heard that the supplied file does not account for. Consumers must treat flagged content as suspect rather than assume completeness.

mode.description: aligned: text is the supplied lyrics file (display truth), timing from Whisper anchoring. transcribed: text AND timing from Whisper on the vocal stem — expect errors on effects-heavy or non-lexical vocals.

engine.description: What produced the timing (and, in transcribed mode, the text). Config-derived except `language`, which may be audio-content-derived — see language_source — and model_fingerprint, which is derived from the local model's files. Not run metadata.

model.description: Pinned model (model_source 'pinned'): the faster-whisper size name, e.g. 'small'. Local model directory (model_source 'local', since 1.3.0): the directory's basename only — never its absolute path, which is machine-specific; model_fingerprint identifies the contents.

language_source.description: Provenance of `language`: 'pinned' from config; 'detected_vocal_window' — detected on a window assembled from the earliest vocal_activity regions, so detection never runs on a silent stem head (review 007 field finding 1); 'default_no_vocal_activity' — the track has NO vocal-activity regions, detection on silence is meaningless and numerically knife-edge, so the configured fallback language is recorded instead (degenerate-case convention, H2; added in 1.1.0).

model_source.description: Provenance of the Whisper weights (added in 1.3.0). 'pinned': a size name resolved to the upstream commit in model_revision, loaded from the local cache at exactly that revision. 'local': a model directory supplied in config — an explicit opt-out of pinning; nothing outside this document ties the weights to a published revision, so treat cross-library comparisons with care. Absent in documents written before 1.3.0.

model_revision.description: Pinned model only: the upstream (Hugging Face) commit sha the weights were loaded at (added in 1.3.0).

model_fingerprint.description: Local model only: sha256 hex over the model directory's files — for every regular file (dot-files and dot-directories skipped, file symlinks followed), the line '<relative POSIX path>\t<sha256 hex of the file>\n', lines sorted by path, concatenated as UTF-8 and hashed. Path-independent; changes whenever any weight or tokenizer file changes, and joins the lyrics stage's inputs_sha256 so such a change marks the document stale (added in 1.3.0).

lines.description: Sorted by start_seconds. In aligned mode, lines mirror the supplied file's sung lines (one entry per line; an .lrc line carrying several time tags yields one entry per tag, all with its source_line_index), anchored to the transcript by a global monotone alignment: lines keep file order on the timeline (an .lrc line with several time tags is expanded and ordered by tag; otherwise hint order replaces file order only when it lets strictly more of the alignment succeed, so one mistyped timestamp never moves its line — hints mainly bias which occurrence a line anchors to) and no transcript word serves two lines. Unanchored lines ('unaligned') get line timing only: a hinted line starts at its .lrc hint corrected by the track-wide hint offset the aligner estimates; k consecutive unhinted lines get evenly spaced starts across the gap between their neighbours, each lasting gap/k but at most 10 s, or 4 s each when nothing follows. Zero-anchor convention: when no line anchors and none is hinted, lines are laid out in file order from 0 s, 4 s each (squeezed evenly when the track is shorter). Every time lies in [0, track duration]. In transcribed mode, lines are Whisper segments.

flags.description: low_confidence: mean word confidence below threshold (config, default 0.5). possibly_non_lexical: hallucination heuristics fired (no_speech_prob / compression_ratio / dictionary hit rate) — text may be invented. overlapping_vocals: sustained dense vocal-stem energy suggests harmonies; words may be merged. long_word_duration: a word exceeds ~2.5 s (melisma); timings smeared. unaligned (aligned mode): line found no transcript anchor; timing absent-quality, taken from lrc hint or neighbor interpolation. timing_interpolated: word times inferred from neighbors rather than observed — on an anchored line, some supplied words had no matching heard word (their times are interpolated between matched neighbours) or two supplied words were heard as one (they split its span). outside_vocal_activity: the line's span overlaps no vocal-activity region — likely hallucinated over instrumental audio; flagged, never dropped (added in 1.1.0).

words.description: Sorted, monotone, within the line span. May be empty for an 'unaligned' line.

confidence.description: transcribed mode: Whisper word probability. aligned mode: token match score between supplied word and the heard word it was paired with by content (for an interpolated word, its best score against the unpaired heard words around it; 0 when there are none).

source_line_index.description: Aligned mode only: 0-based line number in the supplied lyrics file (same numbering as supplied_markup[].source_line_index), so a line can be tied to the section header above it even after the timeline sort (added in 1.2.0).

supplied_markup.description: Present in aligned mode when the supplied lyrics file contained section-header lines like '[Verse 1]' or '[Chorus]'. Header lines are excluded from lines[] and from coverage math (they are not sung); they are recorded here and feed structure.json section labeling as 'supplied_markup' evidence. A header line carrying several leading LRC time tags yields one entry per tag (same source_line_index). Order: by hint_seconds when every entry has one, otherwise by source_line_index (file order).

label.description: Normalized section label when recognizable; 'other' for headers that don't map to the structure vocabulary.

source_line_index.description: 0-based line number in the supplied lyrics file.

hint_seconds.description: Present when the file is .lrc and the header line carried a timestamp.

unmatched_words.description: Aligned mode only (always present there, possibly empty): words Whisper heard that no supplied line was paired with — passages the file omits (repeats it does not write out, ad-libs, backing vocals) or words inserted inside a line. Text and timing are Whisper's; confidence is the Whisper word probability. Sorted by start_seconds. They count toward coverage, so untranscribed_regions keeps meaning 'vocals here, content unknown' (added in 1.2.0).

untranscribed_regions.description: Uncovered spans of vocal activity: the word-covered intervals (lines[].words and, in aligned mode, unmatched_words; zero-length words cover nothing) are subtracted from the vocal-activity regions (audio_features.json). A region with zero word coverage is always emitted whole regardless of length (the 1.0.0 guarantee, preserved — strict superset); fragments of partially-covered regions are emitted when at least `uncovered_min_seconds` long (config, default 1.0). Sharper than the 1.0.0 region-granularity definition, which hid partial misses inside partially-covered regions (review 007 field finding 3; sharpened in 1.1.0 — same shape). The honesty ledger: an LLM consumer should say 'vocals here, content unknown', never pretend silence.

vocal_activity_covered_ratio.description: Fraction of total vocal-activity time overlapped by at least one word (lines[].words and unmatched_words).

lines_flagged_ratio.description: Fraction of lines carrying any flag. A quick trust score for the whole document.
